items.title: US Seeks Forfeiture of $61 Million in Crypto Linked to Alleged Iranian Oil Scheme
items.summary: Prosecutors allege two Chinese companies used Binance accounts to launder oil proceeds benefiting Iran’s government and military.

items.title: MEV Bot Front-Runs $7.8 Million rsETH Exploit on Ethereum
items.summary: Yoink sent 2,882.37 rsETH to one address after its transaction beat the original attack into the same Ethereum block.

items.title: Bitcoin price falls to $75.6K September low as global bonds hit multidecade highs
items.summary: Bitcoin price action weakened over market nerves prior to the Senate CLARITY Act vote, while surging bond yields pressured risk assets across the board.

items.title: Crypto Clarity Act barrels toward disappointment barring last-minute Senate turnaround
items.summary: As the parties dig in their heels, the market structure bill hasn't yet amassed the votes it would need to clear the first Senate hurdle scheduled for Tuesday.
